value.title: Los Monstruos Vienen de Noche
value.synopsis: A new school term begins with Martin as Academic Director, the investigative teens brought to heel through infection, and a monster in the surrounding woods.

value.title: Las Galletas del Porvenir
value.synopsis: As the teen gang renews their friendships, fortune cookie fortunes within Paula's group come to pass - leading up to the dire forecast for Evelyn.

value.title: El Hombre Lobo
value.synopsis: Both Maria and Lucas find themselves disbelieved, one for claiming the birth of a son and having her life threatened, the other for reporting a werewolf in the woods that infiltrates the school by night.

value.title: La Traición
value.synopsis: A mix-up in bottles exposes the fact of a mole among the teens, but it also leaves Ivan without his daily dosage. As Jacques and Hugo seek the identity of the invasive killer creature, Lucas lays hands on Jacques' cash.

value.title: El Baile de los Culpables
value.synopsis: At the school's Feast of Saint Isabel, as Jacques continues to deprive Ivan of medication, Ivan, rather than give up Maria, aims literally to take his dad down during the festivities and expire together.

value.title: Paula y el Lobo
value.synopsis: Hugo begins to understand the wolf man in the woods, Jacques finds his authority undermined, and the teens help Julia face the powerful Paula-like girl ghost.

value.title: La Leyenda de Eva
value.synopsis: As knowledge is power, factions play a three-sided chess game (figuratively) for more. Evelyn, meanwhile, fears she's pregnant, while Carolina seeks the identity of the traitor.

value.title: La Princesa de Hielo
value.synopsis: Carolina's disappearance freaks out her friends as different stories roll in about her sudden departure. They're sure of one thing - Jacques is behind it.

value.title: El Extraterrestre
value.synopsis: As Marcos mourns the loss of Carolina, Rebeca recruits Maria into a dangerous plan, much against Fermin's wishes, and Martin encounters a familiar face he's never met.

value.title: La Habitación Número 13
value.synopsis: Eva's clue leads the teens to discover a sealed bedroom, Fermin fumes over Rebeca getting Maria more deeply involved in intrigue, and the kids hope to get Jacinta "laid."

value.title: El Mago
value.synopsis: With only two factions aware, a countdown barrels toward the activation of lethal biological bombs loosed upon world society. Meanwhile, the kids find Hugo to be magical.

value.title: Alaska
value.synopsis: The wrong determination on which twin survived the night, Hugo or Daniel, could cost lives. Meanwhile, as Marcos works to remove Paula from school, Elsa threatens to blow Alicia's cover if her demand for justice isn't met.

value.title: Después de la Luz
value.synopsis: Evelyn, mistaking Daniel's vial of the death virus as a cologne sample from Paris, intends to make it a gift for Lucas' birthday.
